use: The road family's placement stinger: a short tonal cue layered over the place-rumble and place-thunk when one of the road tiles (straight, bends, junction) settles after a placement or a replace, positional at the tile, on the effects bus, at PLACE_STINGER.level (0.45) times the thunk's placement level, or on demand (hexWorld.audio.play). The runtime routes it (stingerFamily and PLACE_STINGER in web/ui/src/audio-mix.ts), so it lists no event.

provider.name: ElevenLabs
provider.subscription: ElevenLabs Starter (paid, owner account; tier from GET /v1/user/subscription)

prompt: Gentle game placement stinger for a country road: two soft, light, pitched taps on a small hollow wooden woodblock in a mid-high register, tock-tock, a gentle falling interval. Soft felt-mallet attack, warm and rounded, in the family of a cosy wooden game interface. The notes ring briefly and fade to silence within about 0.7 seconds, with silence after. No drum hit, no low thump, no click, no reverb tail, no voices, no other music.

master.format: WAV float32 (target/, not committed; rebuilt by make audio-master)

runtime.command: ffmpeg -nostdin -y -v error -i target/audio-master/sfx/place-stinger-road.wav -map_metadata -1 -fflags +bitexact -flags:a +bitexact -ac 1 -ar 48000 -c:a libopus -b:a 64k -vbr on -compression_level 10 -application audio -frame_duration 20 assets/audio/sfx/place-stinger-road.webm
